messages:

Date: 2026-06-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks — quick procurement/PO question

Hi Mike,

Great to meet you on the demo today — appreciate you walking us through the Celeste use cases. Quick follow-up items from my side to keep the momentum: 

- Recap: Demo covered inference latency targets, multi-region failover, and dedicated capacity options.
- Next steps: procurement readiness and commercial path (PO vs card), any marketplace interest (AWS/GCP), and vendor setup packet if you need finance to proceed.

Could you let me know who on your procurement side manages vendor setup (name/email)? Also, do you expect to pay via Purchase Order or corporate card? If you prefer PO we can share our vendor packet and W-9 right away.

I'll loop in Dylan (SE) and Neha (Legal) if we need to accelerate contract questions.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Thanks — quick procurement/PO question

Hi Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and the demo was helpful.

Procurement handle is Aisha Sharma (cc'd). Our default is to use Purchase Orders for platform contracts, but for small POCs we sometimes do corporate card. For a production Dedicated/Private deployment we'll need PO and a vendor setup in our ERP.

Two quick Qs: 1) Do you support marketplace billing (we prefer AWS Marketplace if possible)? 2) Can you send the vendor packet/W-9 so Aisha can start vendor onboarding?

Thanks,
Mike
Head of ML Platform | Celeste Energy
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Sharma <aisha@celeste-energy.com>
Cc: Mike Li <mike.li@celeste-energy.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood vendor packet + W-9 (next steps for PO)

Hi Aisha — nice to e-meet you. Per Mike's note, attaching the standard vendor setup packet and our W-9 to get things started. The packet includes:

- Company info and legal entity
- Billing address and tax ID (EIN)
- Standard payment terms and instructions for ACH vs check
- Insurance & SOC 2 summary

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_setup_packet.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_W-9.pdf (application/pdf)

Notes on marketplace: we support AWS Marketplace for subscription billing; if you prefer Marketplace billing there are some additional steps (listing + procurement confirmation). If you're primarily looking to pay by PO we can do a direct invoicing flow — we'll need Celeste's vendor code and PO number once Aisha creates the vendor record.

For banking details: we don't include raw bank credentials in email. We can provide an ACH/e-billing form in our secure vendor portal (link below) or exchange banking info via DocuSign as required by your procurement.

Portal link: https://vendor.redwood.com/setup/CE-2026-042
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/CE-2026-042
DocuSign preview: https://redwood.docusign.com/CE-2026-042/contract

If you can confirm:
- Preferred commercial path (PO vs card vs Marketplace)
- Expected timing for vendor setup and PO issuance
- Any special tax docs needed (W-8 if non-US entity)

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to run through the packet. Dylan is available to answer any technical docs Aisha might request.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Sharma <aisha@celeste-energy.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mike Li <mike.li@celeste-energy.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@celeste-energy.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor packet + W-9 (next steps for PO)

Thanks Marissa — I received the packet and W-9. Quick answers:

- We'll proceed with a PO for production.
- Estimated vendor setup complete by 7/6, PO issued by 7/9 (depends on internal approvals).
- We require banking instructions for ACH (routing/account) and a remittance email. We prefer secure portal or DocuSign for bank details.
- AWS Marketplace would be ideal, but that will add ~2 weeks to procurement while our vendor ops validates the listing. If you can do direct invoicing that will be faster for our timeline.

Can you share the official remit-to/billing address line you want on the PO and the invoice email? Also confirm whether Redwood requires a signed Master Services Agreement or if the Marketplace/subscription terms cover it.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior Procurement Manager | Celeste Energy
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Sharma <aisha@celeste-energy.com>, Mike Li <mike.li@celeste-energy.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor packet + W-9 (next steps for PO)

Thanks Aisha — great, this timeline works. Answers below and next steps: 

- Remit-to / billing address for PO: Redwood Inference, 212 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94105. Invoice email: invoices@redwood.com
- We accept ACH; as noted we send ACH wiring details via secure portal/DocuSign (to protect account numbers).
- Contract: For direct invoicing we typically execute a short Master Services Agreement (MSA) with SOW or order form. For Marketplace purchases the Marketplace terms can replace an MSA, but Celeste's procurement tends to prefer our MSA for Dedicated deployments. Neha (cc'd) can confirm any non-standard clauses.

Next steps: 
1) Aisha — once vendor record is created, please share vendor ID and PO number.
2) We'll send a DocuSign envelope with the MSA + ACH/e-billing form for signature (expect from redwood.docusign@redwood.com).
3) Dylan and I will be on standby for any technical or SOC/insurance docs.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 20-min call this week to run through the packet and timeline — here's my calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/marissa/30

Thanks again — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
